title: PixelKin - Kindling (the ceremony)
_note: Plays while a kin kindles: the sprite flickers between its old shape and the new silhouette, faster and faster. 8 bars at 168 (~11.4 s) — KindlePrompt times the animation off this (BAR_MS), so the bloom lands on the bar-8 downbeat. The 'dum-dum-dum' is a pulsing tri_bass heartbeat that never lets up; above it a hushed pulse12 arp walks A minor -> Bb (the phrygian lift: something strange is happening) twice, then climbs C -> D -> E7 so the tension rises bar by bar into the bloom. The lead is a small questioning phrase that keeps reaching one step higher. Loops (Am answers E) as a safety net if the animation is ever held longer.
